reason: A new analytic construction shows that exactly saturated cube capacities can coexist with 32 cliques sharing one cube; this is distinct from the first batch's small-contaminant obstruction.

cases.type: one new exact rational geometry and its finite packet-choice LP
cases.definition: One central cube radius 1 plus cubes of radius 1/2 at every center in {+/-a/2,+/-3a/2}^5 except centers in {+/-a/2}^5; 993 cubes total. Put mass 1+eta uniformly on each of the 32 small common cores centered at a*sigma.
cases.checks: Exact integer geometry for all cube pairs; exact cell arrangement identifying every 32-clique; source incidence; union volume; average and multiplicity defects; every complete clique contains the central cube, so disjoint-index packet selection has at most one member. Compute the exact minimum of the upper_cover014 whole-packet charging expression over these 33 possibilities.

checkpoint_policy: Real PID and progress after each stage; 120-second recoverable deadline; no numerical radius or receiver-space sampling.

same_geometry_amendment_before_rerun.addition: Verify rational inequalities for 32 outer-corner receiver boxes with every signed coordinate between 3/2 and (1+3a)/2. Total-mass radius cutoff and separation from 31 other sources prove these boxes are outside the genuine superlevel set at lambda=1. No new geometry or sampling.

limits: This checks a fixed legal covering family. It does not prove that every possible covering choice has this defect, and does not assert that the witness union is the genuine maximal superlevel set.
